lines.text: Every December, Nora bought her brother hiking gear.
Every year, it was the wrong size, or something he already owned.
Here's the fix. Give him a way to plan and remember his hikes.
A trail journal for every hike,
a tracker for the national parks,
and a planner for the next trip.
By February, his journal had six hikes in it.
Save this for your gift list.
